rationale: Serialize all capacity-affecting transitions with a PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE lock on the activity ledger at READ COMMITTED isolation. Acquire the activity lock before registration/offer locks; perform no network I/O while holding it. Commit state, idempotency records and outbox atomically. This protects the multi-record FIFO and refund rules with one local authority instead of distributed locking, accepting contention on hot activities pending load evidence.
invariants: Occupied confirmed registrations, pending reservations and active offers never exceed frozen capacity.
Paid confirmation requires a correlated approval applied before the persisted expiry, checked using the current database wall clock after locking.
Expiry, refusal, cancellation and repeated results release or promote a slot at most once.
Released slots are offered to eligible FIFO entries atomically before new admissions can bypass them.
Paid-offer acceptance transfers one occupied slot to a new payment reservation without double counting.
Paid cancellation retains confirmed state and occupancy until refund approval; failed refunds retry automatically without limit.
Late approvals cannot resurrect terminal registrations and require manual compensation.
Idempotency-key reuse with a different payload is a conflict, not a second mutation.
